srp_fields.title: Compromise of the G2 update signing pipeline (synthetic)
srp_fields.ar_note: Authorised representative: Example Widgets EU Rep (synthetic).
srp_fields.summary: A build runner of the G2 firmware pipeline was accessed with stolen credentials; integrity of two builds under review.
srp_fields.root_cause: Phishing of a maintainer account (credential theft)
srp_fields.user_action: No user action required at this stage.
srp_fields.measures_taken: Credentials revoked; runner rebuilt from a clean image.
srp_fields.incident_impact: Release of 2.8.2 delayed; no impact on devices in the field identified.
srp_fields.incident_nature: Credential theft followed by access to one CI runner; no evidence of tampering with published builds so far.
srp_fields.incident_severity: Medium: limited to the build environment, no customer device affected so far.
srp_fields.initial_assessment: Two unpublished builds may have been altered; published builds verified against reproducible-build hashes.
srp_fields.measures_for_users: None required; keep automatic updates enabled.
srp_fields.suspected_unlawful: Yes - unauthorised access with stolen credentials
srp_fields.incident_mitigation: Runner isolated, credentials revoked, signing keys moved to HSM-only access.
